title: Student Profile - Africa OpportuScan
description: Profile structure used by the ranking engine. Only fields in ALLOWED_PROFILE_KEYS are read; all other fields are ignored. Nationality and targetLevel are required for eligibility only.

nationality.title: Nationality
nationality.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Used only for eligibility, never for scoring.

residenceCountry.title: Country of residence
residenceCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. Optional and not used in scoring.

age.title: Age
age.description: Optional. Used only when the opportunity has an official age limit. Never used in scoring.

fields.title: Fields of study
fields.description: Field slugs shared with the opportunity dataset.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: A gap is shown as a recommendation and never excludes an opportunity.

preferredDestinations.title: Preferred destinations
preferredDestinations.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes or region slugs. No preference receives full points.
